title: Abagenzi bo mu murima w’ibiti by’icyatsi kibisi
intro: Mu gihe cya kera, abantu babiri bitaga ku butaka bw'abaturanyi. Inzira zabo zari zifatanye, ariko imitima yabo yabayoboraga mu nzira zitandukanye cyane. Umwe yanyuze mu nzira igororotse, undi akayobera mu mwijima wo guhakana. Ese ushobora guhishura ibanga ry'aba bombi bashinzwe gusarura?
clues: Nari mfite imyaka myinshi, umusaruro mwinshi washimishije abarebaga.
Umuturanyi wanjye yari afite ubutunzi bwinshi kundusha, nyamara nifuzaga umugabane wabo kuruta uwanjye.
Nabagiriye inama yo kurimbura imyaka yabo burundu, kugira ngo duhurize hamwe ibintu byose ndi mu maboko yanjye.
Nari narasenyeye umusaruro wanjye, ndangiza byose mu migambi yanjye y'ubupfapfa.
Nahagaze nta cyo nitayeho ubwo imyaka yanjye yarumaga n'ubutunzi bwanjye buhinduka umukungugu mu ijoro rimwe.
Nta mugabane nari mfite mu buzima bw'imperuka, kandi aho nari ntuye habaye umwobo w'umuriro ugurumana.

identity.label: Ndi nde?
options: Umufatanyabikorwa w'umugambanyi wateguye umugambi wo kurimbura

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo

Itegeko ryo kugabanya izungura mu buryo buboneye
trial.answer: Igishuko cyo gusenya imibereho y'umuntu ukiranuka

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Gusenya burundu ibihingwa byombi muri ubu buzima
Guhunga no kuzerera kugeza ku rupfu
Uburumbuke bw'igihe gito bukurikirwa n'umuriro w'iteka
Gusubizwamo ibintu mu buryo bw'igitangaza no gukuba kabiri ibyiza
outcome.answer: Gusenya burundu ibihingwa byombi muri ubu buzima

verse: Then they approached one another, blaming each other. (68:30)
